data.gender_notes: Haqq is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Reality or truth, especially in matters of religion and morality. The name Haqq carries the meaning “Truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Haqq usually hope their child will grow to embody truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the ultimate truth and reality of the universe and God.
data.etymology: Haqq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haqq total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: حق
in_arabic.meaning: الحق هو الصدق و العدل و الحقيقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحق في اللغة العربية يعني الصدق و العدل و الحقيقة. وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، و يعني الحق الذي لا شك فيه. ورد ذكر الحق في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "الحمد لله الذي أنزل الكتاب على عبده ولم يجعل له عوجا".

in_urdu.name: حق
in_urdu.meaning: حق مطلب ہے سچائی انصاف اور حقیقت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حق کا مطلب ہے سچائی، انصاف اور حقیقت۔ یہ اسلامی ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو اللہ کے 99 ناموں میں شامل ہے۔ حق کی اصطلاح عربی زبان سے لی گئی ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سچائی اور انصاف۔ قرآن کریم میں حق کا ذکر کئی بار آیا ہے، جس میں اللہ کی واحدیت اور انصاف کی تاکید کی گئی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हक
in_hindi.meaning: हक का अर्थ है सच्चाई न्याय और वास्तविकता
in_hindi.long_meaning: हक का अर्थ है सच्चाई, न्याय और वास्तविकता। यह एक इस्लामी नाम है जो अल्लाह के 99 नामों में से एक है। हक की शब्दावली अरबी भाषा से ली गई है जिसका अर्थ है सच्चाई और न्याय। कुरआन में हक का उल्लेख कई बार आया है जिसमें अल्लाह की एकता और न्याय पर जोर दिया गया है।

in_pashto.name: حق
in_pashto.meaning: حق د سچايۍ، انصاف او حقيقت معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: حق د سچايۍ، انصاف او حقيقت معنی. دا د الهي نومونو څخه يو دی چی په اسلام کي ورته اشاره کيږي. حق د عربي کلمې څخه اخيستل شوی دی چی د سچايۍ او انصاف مطلب دی. په قران کريم کي د حق ذکر ډیری وارتی راغلی دی، چی د خدای يووالي او انصاف ټينګار پکی دی.

in_english.name: Haqq
in_english.long_meaning: Haqq is an Arabic name that means truth, justice, and reality. It is one of the 99 names of Allah in Islam. The term Haqq is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-q-q' which means to be true, right, or just. In the Quran, Haqq is mentioned numerous times to emphasize the unity of God and the importance of justice and truth. The name Haqq holds significant spiritual and cultural value in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the pursuit of truth and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Haqq" holds great significance in Islamic culture. It is an Arabic term that embodies the essence of truth, authenticity, and certainty. The name is often used to refer to the real nature of Allah and His divine revelations. In Islamic art, calligraphy, and poetry, "Haqq" is a frequent theme, symbolizing the ultimate reality and the search for truth and meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Haqq" is deeply rooted in the Islamic faith. It represents Allah's promise of truth, guidance, and justice. Muslims believe that seeking Haqq (the truth) is a fundamental aspect of their faith and that striving for Haqq will lead them closer to Allah. In Islamic theology, Haqq is also synonymous with Allah's essence, and seeking Haqq is akin to seeking Allah himself. Therefore, the name "Haqq" serves as a powerful reminder of the importance of truth and authenticity, both in religious matters and in one's daily life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Truth" symbolizes Reality or truth, especially in matters of religion and morality.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Haqq serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of truth.
